title: Ranook hotel reservation
titleCn: 拉努克酒店订房电话对话

paragraphs.text: Hello, I'm looking to book a hotel room for an upcoming trip.
Welcome.
We're delighted to assist you with your reservation at Ranook Hotel.
We offer a variety of room options, including the garden room for business travelers, the executive room, and the power room, ideal for families with extra beds or a sofa bed.
I believe the power room will be perfect for my family.
Excellent choice. Could you please provide me with your telephone number so we can keep you updated on your booking?
Certainly. My number is 0416334082.
Thank you.
And may I have your name for the booking?
I'm Ethan Ascot. A-S-C-O-T.
When do you plan to check in and out?
We'll check in on July 6th when our family holiday begins, and check out on July 8th.
The room rate for tonight is 250 dollars at a discounted rate, reduced from the original price of 265 dollars.
Do you have any specific room preferences?
I'd love a room with a view of the river, a change from my usual work environment.
Noted.
We'll ensure your room meets that requirement.
We also offer two packages: the luxurious package with a three-day trip near the hotel and the value package where you can plan your own activities.
It's more economical and suitable for families.
I'll opt for the second one. Could you also tell me the hotel's location?
Certainly.
We're located in the east of the city, approximately a twenty kilometers drive from the city center.
Is there anything else you need assistance with?
I was hoping to be near a beach for leisurely walks.
You're in luck.
We're a seaside hotel, so you can enjoy relaxing beach walks easily.
We'll provide you with a map to explore nearby scenic spots effortlessly.
